messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a public holiday that falls on a Friday or Monday, creating a three‑day break that includes the weekend.)

| # | Holiday | Observed Date (2023) | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---|---------|----------------------|-------------------|
| 1 | New Year’s Day (observed) | **Mon Jan 02** | **Sat Dec 31 2022 – Mon Jan 02 2023** |
| 2 | Good Friday | **Fri Apr 07** | **Fri Apr 07 – Sun Apr 09** |
| 3 | Victoria Day | **Mon May 22** | **Mon May 20 – Mon May 22** |
| 4 | Canada Day (observed) | **Mon Jul 03** | **Sat Jul 01 – Mon Jul 03** |
| 5 | Labour Day | **Mon Sep 04** | **Mon Sep 02 – Mon Sep 04** |
| 6 | Thanksgiving | **Mon Oct 09** | **Mon Oct 07 – Mon Oct 09** |
| 7 | Christmas Day | **Mon Dec 25** | **Sun Dec 24 – Tue Dec 26** |

> **Notes**  
> * The “observed” dates (e.g., New Year’s Day on Jan 2, Canada Day on Jul 3) are the days on which the holiday is actually taken off work when the statutory holiday falls on a weekend.  
> * Some holidays (Family Day, Civic Holiday, etc.) are province‑specific and do not create nationwide long weekends, so they’re omitted here.  

Feel free to copy/paste this table into your holiday‑planning app or adapt it to your preferred format!
